data.one_liner: Cross‑platform video and audio player for Flutter and Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified Player API that supports video, audio, subtitles, playlists, and hardware acceleration on Android, iOS, web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
use_when: You need a single package that handles both video and audio playback
You require hardware/GPU acceleration and wide format support
You want to avoid multiple platform‑specific player packages
avoid_when: You only need simple audio playback
You prefer a minimal dependency footprint
You are targeting a single platform and can use a native player
weaknesses: Large bundle size if both video and audio are used
data.setup_notes: Add media_kit, media_kit_video, and media_kit_libs_video (or audio) to pubspec. Call MediaKit.ensureInitialized() before runApp. No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Single package, simpler API, widely used for video playback
